verses.1: Who will give you as a brother to me? You are the one who will take care of my mother’s fields. I will find you in the wilderness, and I will drink from your waters. They will not be taken away from me.
verses.2: I will take you to my mother’s house. There, she will teach me how to drink from the purest water.
verses.3: May She be under my head, and her right hand may hold me.
verses.4: I praise you, daughters of Jerusalem! What will you do to stir up love once more?
verses.5: Who is it that rises from the sea, descending upon your beloved under the light of your rising sun? Your sorrow, my beloved, your sorrow… your child’s sorrow.
verses.6: Keep me safe, like a shadow over your heart, like a shadow over your branches. For love is hard to bear, just as jealousy is also difficult to endure. Its flames are like those of a burning fire.
verses.7: Many waters cannot extinguish love. Rivers cannot wash away it, if someone gives all his possessions in love. Then they will flow towards him.
verses.8: Our sister is small and delicate. There’s nothing that can be done for her on the day when she passes away.
verses.9: If it’s a house, then it’s built with silver and gold. And if it’s a door, then it’s made of iron.
verses.10: I am hot and thirsty, just like in that great place. Then, in his eyes, I was like a source of comfort.
verses.11: Kerem was given to Shlomo by the man who owned it. The owner gave Kerem to the nethim. One man brought back one thousand pieces of silver from his journey.
verses.12: My vineyard lies before you, O perfect one. May you harvest its fruit for yourself.
verses.13: Those who sit in the gardens, they listen to the voice of my ears.
verses.14: Oh my father, you resemble a lion or a bird that flies over the mountains in the sky.
